_about: 3D body motion of SEVERAL people from a video (ComfyUI core nodes). SAM 3.1 (Meta, SAM License; Comfy-Org repackage) finds every 'person' and follows each through the video (SAM3_VideoTrack, numbered 0..max_people-1 in the order found); SAM3DBody_Predict reads each tracked person's 3D joints inside its own mask; BuildPoseFile writes one 'trackNN' per SAM 3 object (NN = the object's number) with the root at its ABSOLUTE camera-space place (camera_translation 'absolute': the people keep their distances; depth from one camera is a guess). In a frame where a person is not visible SAM 3D Body still predicts something (a full-frame box): the label video (each object's mask in a flat colour on black, SAM3_TrackPreview without images) tells cinestudio/mocap.py which frames each person is really in. 'preview' = the video with the numbered masks (who is who). The one-person graph (sam3d_body) stays the default. Used by cinestudio/video_template.py (shot from-video --people 2|pick).
